design_intent: A bridge-aligned, human-scale signal portal whose three unequal bronze bells are readable from both rope-span approaches without narrowing the deck.
_signal_note: P2-053: warm signal lenses sit in bronze lantern cages, supported above the crown beam. Their smaller bodies and low emission keep the three bells primary. Presentation only; no collision, route state or light changes.
_bell_light_note: P2-053 night hierarchy candidate: the existing two warm lights hang outside the flared bell lips, on opposite faces of the crown beam. Their small bronze housings explain the light without changing the two route signals, collision or light budget. Native day/night comparison remains required.
